As part of the training in becoming a [[mesmer]], [[Lady Althea]] asks that a [[Rogue Bull|rogue bull]] threatening a [[Lakeside County|watering hole]] be eliminated.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = y
| profession = mesmer
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Kill the [[Rogue Bull]] that is threatening Althea's theatre.
* Return to [[Lady Althea]] for your reward.

===Early benefits===
* Lady Althea will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
** {{skill icon|Conjure Phantasm}}
** {{skill icon|Ether Feast}}
** {{skill icon|Imagined Burden}}

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]

===Environmental changes===
* After completing this quest, even before accepting the reward, the Rogue Bull no longer spawns on entering Lakeside County. Instead, [[Old Mac]] spawns near the gate and will offer [[The Rogue's Replacement]].
** This change requires that all members of the party have completed the quest.

==Walkthrough==
Head roughly south-west towards the pool of water to find the Rogue Bull. The Rogue Bull has a high armor rating, so armor ignoring skills (such as [[Bane Signet]], [[Banish]] or [[Empathy]]) and health degeneration skills (such as [[Conjure Phantasm]] or [[Sever Artery]]) are useful here. Because the bull is quite a high level, consider bringing healing skills such as [[Orison of Healing]] or [[Troll Unguent]]. Also be wary of the Rogue Bull's skill, [[Bull's Charge]], as this can cause [[knock down]], particularly if you are attempting to flee. Once the bull is dead, return to Lady Althea for your reward.
